info.name: Aiden API
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for testing the Aiden platform. This collection includes endpoints for user authentication, profile management, inventory, auctions, orders, and more. Each folder is organized by app and functionality.

variable.description: Base URL for the API
JWT access token for authenticated requests
JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens
ID of a seller for testing seller-specific endpoints
ID of a buyer for testing buyer-specific endpoints
ID of a product for testing product-specific endpoints
ID of a listing for testing listing-specific endpoints
ID of an auction for testing auction-specific endpoints

item.name: Accounts App
item.description: Endpoints for user authentication, profile management, and admin operations

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user authentication including login, registration, token refresh, and logout

request.description: Register a new user with company information. This endpoint creates a new user account and organization. The role can be 'buyer' or 'seller'.

Login with email and password to get JWT tokens. This endpoint returns an access token and a refresh token. The access token should be included in the Authorization header for authenticated requests. The refresh token can be used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires.
Refresh access token using refresh token. This endpoint is used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires. The refresh token has a longer lifespan than the access token.
Logout and blacklist the refresh token. This endpoint invalidates the refresh token, preventing it from being used to obtain new access tokens. The access token will still be valid until it expires.

item.name: Profile Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing user profiles, including retrieving profile information, changing passwords, and accepting terms of service

request.description: Get user profile information. This endpoint returns detailed information about the authenticated user, including their organization details and role.
Change user password. This endpoint allows users to change their password by providing their current password and a new password.
Accept terms of service. This endpoint allows users to accept the terms of service, which is required for using certain features of the platform.

request.description: List all network relationships. For sellers, this endpoint returns their relationships with buyers. For buyers, it returns their relationships with sellers.
